title: Outbox Queue & Idempotency Key Retry
description: Trace how an IndexedDB outbox persists a mutation key, survives a dropped response, and deduplicates on retry.

steps.label: 1. Enqueue Intent with Fixed UUID
steps.description: User submits order; client generates Idempotency-Key once, writes to IndexedDB, and updates UI optimistically.

steps.label: 2. Network Drops After Server Commit
steps.description: First POST commits on server, but cellular drop loses the 200 OK; client keeps item in outbox and retries with same key.

steps.label: 3. Replay Cached 200 & Dequeue
steps.description: Server recognizes '9b1d-4c2a', replays the original 200 OK without double-charging, and client removes item #1.
